Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

nexdata product2145 · access terms: Nexdata’s product 2145 page labels the collection as a paid dataset licensed for commercial use andoffers sample/quote requests.

Permanent record ID: candidate.add17.nexdata2145.access.v2

  • The public label is not an executed license orblanket upstream rights clearance; the catalog says terms depend on intended application, geography andproject requirements.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

nexdata product2145 · documents: The product 2145 specifications describe a PICO 4 Ultra head-mounted stereo camera plus wrist andankle IMUs, 4096×1536 video at thirty frames per second and seventy-six tracked joints comprising twenty-four torso and fifty-two hand joints.

Permanent record ID: candidate.add17.nexdata2145.capture.v2

  • These are publisher-reported acquisition/output specifications, not independently measured synchronization, tracking orsensor-quality results.
  • Nexdata is the publisher of this product description; upstream creation, ownership, participant permissions and individual annotation responsibilities are not established by the listing.

nexdata product2145 · dataset size: Nexdata’s product 2145 page describes twenty thousand hours of egocentric video across residential, retail andoffice scenarios, pairing stereo video and calibration with full-body pose and step-by-step action labels.

Permanent record ID: candidate.add17.nexdata2145.units.v2

  • Nexdata is the publisher of this product description; upstream creation, ownership, participant permissions and individual annotation responsibilities are not established by the listing.
